category_decisions.reason: Submit only after verified public launch and release/growth metrics.
Requires public links and a short evidence-backed description of how public building improved the app.
Weekkeep is not a game and will not add game scope.
Submit only with direct parent evidence about reduced memory-keeping burden or privacy understanding.
The exact-seven visual system, review interaction, restraint, and local-first trust are the strongest fit.

This category is about creative/effective use of RevenueCat Ads, not cat-themed advertising. Weekkeep does not use RevenueCat Ads and will not add interruptive ads merely to chase the category because that conflicts with the calm product experience.
Weekkeep is being submitted on the non-Next-Gen app track.
Submit with verified pricing, paywall, conversion, and revenue evidence.
No qualifying conflict-of-interest case is part of the Weekkeep submission.
Weekkeep is a parent memory product, not a general productivity tool.
The product is not about nutrition or healthy eating.
The product is not about yoga or fitness.
The product is not career coaching.
Weekkeep is not a game and will not add gaming scope.
Weekkeep is a Swift/iOS app; Kotlin or JetBrains scope will not be added.
Submit only if a live Noise campaign/account was actually used and measured.
Weekkeep targets iPhone, not Galaxy devices or the Samsung store.
There is no verified Replit build evidence and no Replit scope will be added.
V1 uses local notifications and explicitly excludes OneSignal and remote push.
There is no Layers integration or separate growth-loop scope, and no SDK will be added.

The category requires a live web-to-app funnel using RevenueCat Funnels with Stripe; Weekkeep has no such live funnel. V1 uses a native App Store non-consumable purchase through RevenueCat, and we will not add a web funnel only to chase the category.
